set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-film.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Coverage gaps explicitly recorded in evidence/movie-time-contract-closeout-20260923; do not reopen the closed baseline clock contract or make these new 1.0 prerequisites.

Remaining / next action: Retain edition/audio extent when picture samples are absent, without inventing picture support or dropping playback time. These are existing 1.1 synthetic qualification courts; no licensed media is needed.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Existing missing court from bd-01M199ABAG5SXR9C6Y0G4X6J2T; its 2026-09-22 disposition requires an explicit film child per uncovered court. This records existing 1.1 film qualification scope, not a new 1.0 prerequisite.

Acceptance: Existing audio packet tiling does not prove edition extent. Add a synthetic edition interval with continuing admitted audio and absent picture; preserve playback support and authority-track semantics. Kill a mutation that drops or invents picture support.

Evidence: exact source SHA, independent answers where numeric, named compiling mutant/control, scoped portable gate and independent review. No licensed media or participant data required.

Coverage audit: docs/refactor/evidence/movie-time-contract-closeout-20260923/README.md.
